ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jun-07-2012 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 514, Judge: Donald J. Sullivan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Maria Viscio #12353

Petitioner Catherine Rubald present in pro per as guardian ad litem for the minor Anna Otelia Rubald Catt, placed under oath and examined.
Proof of Publication is in the file.
No appearance by the Co-Petitioner Rachel A. Catt.
Based on representations of the Petitioner that Minor was adopted and no objections to the proposed change of name of a minor were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the Minor to Anna Otelia Catt-Rubald.
Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.
